page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. System memory provides 31.0 GB of RAM, allocating 3.88 GB per core, supported by a 33 MB L3 cache and AVX-512 vector instructions. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single dedicated NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 5 Gbps baseline network interface and includes no bundled local storage.

Performance benchmarks show specialized capability driven by the GPU hardware accelerator. While CPU-bound execution scores low in single-core and multi-core synthetic tests, such as Geekbench single-core at 935 and multi-core at 3617, the onboard NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers high throughput for deep learning inference. Small and medium LLM prompt processing achieves top-tier rates of 8,407.18 tokens per second on 135M models and 1,134.43 tokens per second on 7B models. Text generation for 7B models reaches 33.96 tokens per second. Uncached memory bandwidth averages 39.4 GB/sec for reads and 36.26 GB/sec for writes.

The lack of local ephemeral storage requires reliance on external network-attached volumes for data persistent workloads. From a hardware profile standpoint, offloading parallel math computations to the integrated T4 GPU delivers optimal resource efficiency for inference tasks without requiring high host CPU counts. The server is well suited for real-time AI model inference, computer vision pipelines, light deep learning tasks, and GPU-accelerated video processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server designed for AI inference and graphics processing. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 CPU running at 2.5 GHz across 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs, it features 31.0 GB of system memory and 33 MB of L3 cache. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance operates on KVM hypervisors with a 5 Gbps network interface and no bundled local storage. Benchmarks highlight strong GPU inference metrics, achieving top-tier prompt processing throughput of 1,134.43 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, despite modest CPU synthetic benchmark scores. Without local storage, network attachment is required for persistent data. This server profile offers efficient hardware offloading for deep learning inference, image processing, and video encoding workloads.
